1. [CLAIM-SAAS-1] Reduces mean time to resolution (MTTR) by up to 43% according to customer telemetry benchmarks.
2. [CLAIM-SAAS-2] Rollout requires under 15 minutes per Kubernetes cluster with zero agent restarts.
3. [CLAIM-SAAS-3] Agent CPU overhead is measured at less than 1.5% under peak traffic.
4. [CLAIM-SAAS-4] Certified SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant infrastructure.
5. [CLAIM-SAAS-5] Supports open standards including OpenTelemetry and Prometheus out of the box.
